mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_division (animal_cage_id, assignee_id, assignee_name, group_name, created_by, created_by_name) VALUES (#{animalCageId}, #{assigneeId}, #{assigneeName}, #{groupName}, #{createdBy}, #{createdByName})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_division WHERE animal_cage_id IN #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_division WHERE animal_cage_id IN #{id} ORDER BY animal_cage_id ASC, id ASC
